name: Dynamic Prompt
description: Turns a template into one prompt: {red|green|blue} picks one, {2$$a|b|c} picks several, __colours__ takes a line of a wildcard file, ${v=...} stores a value. The same template, seed and wildcard files give the same prompt.

inputs.name: template
inputs.label: Template
inputs.description: The prompt with dynamic syntax, as in A1111's Dynamic Prompts: {a|b|c} picks one, {0.5::a|0.2::b} weights, {2$$a|b|c} picks two, {1-3$$ and $$a|b|c} one to three joined by ' and '. __name__ takes a line of name.txt (or a list in a .yaml or .json file) from the wildcards folders; __colours*__ and __people/**__ match several files. ${v=...} sets a variable, ${v=!...} picks once, ${v} and ${v:default} use it, __name(v=value)__ passes it. # starts a comment at the start of a line or before a space; \# is a literal #. Newlines count as spaces.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.description: Which prompt of the template: the same seed gives the same prompt, another seed another one.
